major_cooldowns.name: Metamorphosis
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Enter it on cooldown with maximum Souls for the Spirit Bomb reset, and skip it while an active Metamorphosis still has more than 5 seconds left because a re-press overwrites the duration instead of extending it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 187827 is the Vengeance tank cast and self aura; 191427 and 162264 share the name and belong to the Havoc version.

major_cooldowns.name: Fel Devastation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it on cooldown once you hold at least 50 Fury, and sync one cast with Fiery Brand when you run Fiery Demise and Down in Flames.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Guide gives 28 to 34 seconds with Darkglare Boon; 40 is the untalented base from the table.

major_cooldowns.name: Fiery Brand
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Brand the target whenever the debuff is not active and line the window up with Soul Carver, Sigil of Spite and Fel Devastation for the Fiery Demise damage bonus.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 204021 is the cast; 207771 is the aura it applies. Guide gives 48 seconds with Down in Flames, table base is 60.

major_cooldowns.name: Sigil of Spite
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it on cooldown whenever the Souls it returns will not overcap you, ideally with Fiery Brand already on the target.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 390163 is the observed cast id; 389860 shares the name and is not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Soul Carver
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown at fewer than 3 Souls so none of its fragments are wasted, and sync it with Fiery Brand when you run Fiery Demise.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip; the guide lists it as a build option.

major_cooldowns.name: Immolation Aura
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown right behind Fracture, and move it ahead of your spenders in AoE with Fallout or while Fiery Brand is active with Charred Flesh.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 258920 is the observed cast and self aura; 427917 and 258921 share the name.

major_cooldowns.name: Sigil of Flame
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Precast it before the pull, then use it on cooldown and place it once the pack is grouped in AoE.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 204596 is the cast; 204598 is the enemy debuff.

defensives.name: Metamorphosis
defensives.usage_rule: Take it on cooldown for the health and armor, but not while a proc has you in Metamorphosis with more than 5 seconds left.

defensives.name: Fiery Brand
defensives.usage_rule: Brand whatever is hitting you on cooldown, holding it up to 10 seconds for a large tankbuster.

defensives.name: Fel Devastation
defensives.usage_rule: Channel it once you drop below 70% health to heal back up.

defensives.name: Demon Spikes
defensives.usage_rule: Press it whenever no other defensive is active, or when the charge would fully recharge before your current defensive ends.
defensives.id_note: 203720 is the cast; 203819 is the self aura.

defensives.name: Darkness
defensives.usage_rule: Use it as often as you can, saving it for group damage phases with several hits or for pulls with many adds.

rules.description: Open Immolation Aura, Fiery Brand, then Metamorphosis
rules.action: Chain Immolation Aura, Fiery Brand, Metamorphosis and Fel Devastation in that order once you land on the pack.

rules.description: Hold Sigil of Spite and Soul Carver for Fiery Brand
rules.action: Brand first, then send them inside the Fiery Demise window.
Press it off global whenever it drops and no other defensive is covering you.

rules.description: Felblade over Fracture while spending Voidfall
rules.action: Build with Felblade while you are spending Voidfall stacks, since Fracture cannot generate there.

rules.description: Follow Spirit Bomb with Soul Cleave
rules.action: Send Soul Cleave on the next global after a Spirit Bomb that flips Voidfall into spending.

rules.description: Press Felblade only with room left on Fury
rules.action: Dump into Soul Cleave first and save Felblade for refilling Fury.

source_summary: Vengeance presses everything on cooldown and never lets a generator idle: Fracture, Immolation Aura and Sigil of Flame feed Souls and Fury into Spirit Bomb and Soul Cleave. Fiery Brand is the damage anchor, so Soul Carver, Sigil of Spite and Fel Devastation line up behind it when Fiery Demise is talented. Metamorphosis is entered on cooldown with full Souls for the Spirit Bomb reset, while Demon Spikes covers every gap between the bigger defensives.
